user_story: As a guest, I want to filter bookings by status so that I can see only pending, confirmed, or cancelled reservations.

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'pending'
steps: Select 'pending' from the status filter drop-down.
positive.expected_result: Only reservations with status 'pending' should be displayed.

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'confirmed'
steps: Select 'confirmed' from the status filter drop-down.
positive.expected_result: Only reservations with status 'confirmed' should be displayed.

positive.title: Filter bookings by status 'cancelled'
steps: Select 'cancelled' from the status filter drop-down.
positive.expected_result: Only reservations with status 'cancelled' should be displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to filter bookings with no status selected
steps: Leave the status filter drop-down unselected or select a blank option.
negative.expected_result: An error message should display indicating a status must be selected to apply a filter.

edge.title: Filter bookings with a status not existing in the system
steps: Manually enter a non-existing status, such as 'archived', into the status filter input.
edge.expected_result: No reservations should be displayed, and the system should either show a message indicating no results or reset to show all bookings.
